verdict.rationale: Svelte is an open-source UI framework and compiler that runs in the developer's own toolchain (the documented MCP server also runs locally via npx), so it holds no user data. User-controlled data retention and deletion is a hosted-service privacy axis and does not apply to this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Svelte hosting or retaining user data in a way that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
